text:
In pleasure, there is the fear of disease; in family, the fear of downfall; in wealth, the fear of the king.
In honor, the fear of poverty; in power, the fear of enemies; in beauty, the fear of old age.
In scholarship, the fear of rivals; in virtue, the fear of the wicked; in the body, the fear of death.
Everything in this world for humans is fraught with fear; only detachment is true fearlessness.
